label: Contradiction-8
title: K-008: Which flaw was shown to give code execution on PHP-FPM?
description: The advisories, written by the PHP security team per CVE, put the demonstrated FPM exploit under CVE-2026-109619, and say none was demonstrated for CVE-2026-109618. The Foundation's blog places FPM confirmation under CVE-2026-109618. The blog appears to have swapped the attribution. That RCE was shown on FPM is not in doubt; which flaw does it is.
